title: Red-gate budget record (F153-FR-020 to -023; data-model.md D3)
description: The durable red-gate budget count of one (run, phase), derived from the gate result records of the phase and written beside them after each red gate (budget A of CQ-153-05, answered 2026-11-13). Read by the red-gate budget table and by `afterARejection` to decide the halt; survives a resume and a relaunch because it points at the records it was derived from, and it is set aside with the other counts by a reset of the ledger (F153-FR-021). PROPOSAL of spec 153 — not normative until its tasks land.

count.$comment: the red gates of the phase since the counts were reset — every gate result record whose code is not 0, a code 3 (could not run) like a code 10 (failed), F153-FR-023

limit.$comment: the configuration value the count is counted against (`verification.redGate.limit`), recorded with the increments it produced

record.$comment: the logical name of the gate result record this increment was derived from (`attempt:<N>:<k>:<n>:verification`)
